description: HELD-OUT set. Generated 2026-09-08 by an independent Claude subagent that saw only the requirement taxonomy labels (platforms/modes/inputs/screens/negatives/missing) and NO knowledge records, lexicon, or existing eval cases. Expectations are label sets and concept phrases matched against returned text, never record ids. Frozen for Phase 2: not used for tuning retrieval weights, lexicon entries, or records. Invalid cases are moved to archive.json with a reason, never rewritten.
